location.precision_note: Air quality is a regional model-grid estimate, not a station reading or street-level measurement. Nearby places can share the same forecast. A forecast does not establish a venue's quality, access or safety.

warnings: If you are unusually sensitive to air pollution, consider reducing prolonged or heavy outdoor exertion.
Peak hourly rain chance is 2%; this is not the probability of rain over the entire outing.
reasons: Chosen from complete forecast windows that match your requested duration and period.
Pollution/rain/heat preference score: 102.8; lower is preferred. This score is not a health-risk percentage.
AQI guidance uses the worst hour, so the average cannot hide a more polluted hour.
checklist: Recheck the forecast before leaving; conditions can change.
Confirm the resolved location and venue access or opening hours before travelling.
Have a rain plan and check wet or slippery surfaces locally.
